title: Online Intervention To Improve Motivation
official: An Online Intervention To Enhance Motivation and Goal-Directed Behavior
summary: Participants will complete one online intervention lasting 12 weeks. Each week, they will be asked to complete a 20-30 minute session online. The intervention is targeting improved mood and positive affect in order to support increases in motivation and goal-directed behavior. Before and after the intervention, participants will be asked to complete measures to assess symptoms, mood, and behavior.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of schizophrenia or a related psychotic disorder
* Meeting criteria for being at clinical high risk for psychosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Does not have access to a computer each week
